# KaTeX 0.15.3

Vendored from the KaTeX distribution supplied with the locally installed R documentation (`/usr/share/R/doc/html/katex/`). Upstream: https://katex.org/.

`katex.js`, `katex.css`, and `fonts/` are distributed together so Beta Buds' derivation renders without a network connection or build step. The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

This renderer is used only for authored, static mathematical expressions, with `trust: false`. No user-provided LaTeX is accepted. When replacing this bundle, update JavaScript, CSS, fonts, license, and this version note together.
